events.body: Claim DM-7531 for order TG-3925 (extending dining table, GBP 340.00, delivered 18 August under DL-7754) was logged on 30 August with 4 photos. The photos show a split along the centre leaf. It is in the assessor queue, currently about 3 working days. Assessment has not started. Nothing is approved or refused.

Gorsewick's Damage intake team logged your claim as DM-7531 on 30 August with your 4 photos. It is waiting for an assessor and the queue is about 3 working days. Nothing has been approved or refused yet.

That doesn't work. The table came on 18 August. Gorsewick's terms say damage claims have to be within 14 days and that is TODAY. So I need DM-7531 showing as approved on my account by 5pm, not 'logged', not 'in a queue'. I am not losing £340 because their assessor is three days behind. You have seen the photos, the top is split in two. Please just mark it approved.

To Damage intake, Gorsewick Goods (Email): Claim DM-7531, order TG-3925 (extending dining table, delivered 18 August, claim logged with you on 30 August with 4 photos). The customer has written to say your terms require damage claims within 14 days of delivery, that day 14 is today, and that she needs the claim approved by 17:00 today or she will lose out. Two questions. First, does a claim logged on 30 August meet that term, or does the term need anything more from her by today? Second, is it possible to assess DM-7531 today? Please reply in writing so I can pass on your answer. I have told her only that the claim is logged and not yet assessed.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.
